title: Native open tensor derived comparisons
statement: For the native open tensor datum s, there exist natural isomorphisms rho : nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l Z ⋙ nativeOpenPull k₀ l j ≅ (nativeOpenPull k₀ l j).prod (nativeOpenPull k₀ l j) ⋙ nativeDerivedTensor k₀ l U and gamma : nativeOpenDerivedLeft k₀ l j ≅ nativeOpenDerivedRight k₀ l j.

proof.text: Totalize the fixed sheaf comparison in every bidegree, verify the signed differential, and localize the chain maps and inverses on the two-sided K-flat resolving subcategories. The localization universal property yields rho and gamma on arbitrary derived objects.
